_help: The featured-partner banner right under the home-page hero: one partner at a time, a slot you can sell. 'partner' is a restaurant key from restaurant-offers.json or a brand key from brands.json; the wording, logo and link come from that partner. To write your own wording add "title", "text" and/or "cta" as { "en": "...", "ar": "..." }, and "url" to link somewhere else. Set "sponsored" to true when the partner pays for the slot: it is then labelled Sponsored / إعلان (required for paid placements) and outside links get rel="sponsored". The banner hides itself after "until" (YYYY-MM-DD, Cairo time), even without a rebuild. Set "active" to false to remove it. Then run: perl tools/build.pl
